text:
Sam H: handing over night shift. Primary = me (Sam H) until 02:00 UTC. Ongoing: INC-5021 — embeddings-queue backpressure in eu-west-1 causing p99 tails and some 503s. customer impact: intermittent failures for batch embedding jobs and a handful of realtime requests. Notified CS about affected customers (ID: cust-4829).

Anya V: thanks — I have the primary starting 02:00 UTC. quick summary of current mitigations?

Sam H: current mitigations:
- scaled embeddings pool from 8 -> 12 nodes (manual)
- enabled `queue_shed_mode: conservative` on routing to drop large bulk jobs
- activated KV cache prefixing for top prefixes (reduced duplicate work)
- temporarily routing non-critical traffic to `model-emb-lite` variant

Carlos M: logs show a surge of large batched jobs around 01:10 UTC. snippet:
```
2026-03-14T01:10:23Z WARN queue_manager: job_size=12500 tokens source=third-party-batcher queue_wait_ms=8421
```

Priya S: FYI alerting:
- Pager: embeddings-queue-high-latency (firing)
- Metric: queue_time.p99 > 3s for last 10m
- Error spike: 503s from embeddings-service (5xx-rate ~ 0.8%)

incident-bot: Pager opened for INC-5021. Severity: Sev2. Assigned: Sam H (primary), Anya V (secondary).

Sam H: runbook refs:
- Embeddings queue backpressure runbook: https://wiki.internal.redwood/ops/embeddings-backpressure
- Quick playbook for immediate mitigation: https://wiki.internal.redwood/ops/embeddings-playbooks#scale-jump
Commands I ran:
```
# scale pool
redwoodctl infra scale --pool embeddings-eu-west --count 12
# check queue
redwoodctl metrics query 'queue_time.p99{pool="embeddings-eu-west"}' --range 15m
```

Anya V: gaps / things to watch during my shift:
1) Watch the autoscaler errors — last time the autoscaler failed due to SSH key rotation.
2) If p99 stays >3s after 15m, swap routing to `model-emb-slim` and start draining largest batchers.
3) Customer comms: CS drafted a short note, but for persistent impact ask for approval from @Elena.

Carlos M: I'm going to leave a checklist in the thread for handover to oncoming team at 06:00 UTC:
- current pool size
- p99 queue time
- 5xx rate
- active long-running jobs (IDs)

Sam H: night notes: please don't run full-cluster restarts unless asked. We've validated memcache and kv stores are healthy. If you need to throttle job submitters, use `queue_shed_mode: aggressive` as last resort.

oncall-bot: Reminder — please update the thread topic with final status at end of shift. :memo:

Priya S: taking secondary from now until 06:00 UTC. I'll be on call and reachable via pager and DM. If anything escalates to Sev1, escalate to Eng SRE lead.

Anya V: thanks — acknowledged. I'll post a brief status update at 02:15 UTC and again at 04:30 UTC. :thumbsup:

Sam H: handing off. current status: pool scaled, p99 dropped from ~4.2s -> ~2.8s after scale; 5xx rate steady at 0.6%. keep an eye on bulk job sources and preempt if necessary. good luck.
